title: Sample preparation for 2b-RAD genotyping
protocol: Prepare intact, high-quality genomic DNA samples each containing 1 µg at a concentration of at least 250 ng/μl.
Dilute all samples to the same volume of 4 μl with nuclease-free water.
Combine 0.6 μl 10X Buffer R, 0.4 μl 150 μM SAM, and 1.0 U AlfI in a single tube for restriction digest master mix.
Add nuclease-free water to the master mix to achieve a total volume of 2.0 μl.
Combine 2 μl master mix with each 4 μl DNA sample.
Incubate the combined samples at 37°C for 1 hour.
Inactivate the enzyme by incubating the samples at 65°C for 20 minutes and then hold on ice.
Prepare two partially double-stranded adaptors by combining sld-ada1-AlfI and anti-sld-ada1 to form adaptor 1.
Combine sld-ada2-AlfI and anti-sld-ada2 to form adaptor 2.
Prepare a master mix for ligation by combining 0.5 μl 10 mM ATP, 2.0 μl 10X T4 ligase buffer, 2.5 μl 5 μM Adaptor 1, and 2.5 μl 5 μM Adaptor 2 in a single tube.
Add nuclease-free water to the ligation master mix to achieve the total volume needed for the reaction.
Combine 20 µl master mix with 5 µl of digested DNA.
Incubate for 1 hour (16°C for heat-inactivatable enzymes e.g., AlfI, or at 4°C for enzymes that cannot be inactivated, e.g., BsaXI).
Hold on ice after incubation.
Conduct a test-scale PCR to determine the minimum number of cycles required to produce a visible product and evaluate relative yield across samples.
Prepare a master mix for PCR by combining NFW, dNTPs, primers, buffer, and polymerase in a single tube and mixing thoroughly.
Combine 16 µl master mix with 4 µl ligation from each sample.
Amplify on the profile of 98°C for 5 sec, 60°C for 20 sec, and 72°C for 10 sec for 12 cycles.
Sample 5 μl from each reaction at two-cycle intervals (n = 6, 8, 10, & 12 cycles).
Visualize PCR products using standard gel electrophoresis methods on a 2% agarose TBE gel including a low-molecular weight marker.
Select the minimum number of cycles required to produce a visible product at ~130 bp.

Combine 32.5 µl NFW, 12.5 µl 2.5 mM dNTP, 2.0 µl 10 µM sld-p5, 2.0 µl 10 µM sld-p6, 5.0 µl 1 µM sld-p3, 5.0 µl 1 µM sld-p4 (barcode), 20.0 µl 5X HF buffer, and 1.0 µl Phusion polymerase to prepare a master mix.
Combine 80 µl master mix with 20 µl ligation and amplify using the optimal cycle number determined in step 4.
Resolve samples on 2% agarose gels using standard electrophoresis methods and reagents.
Excise the target band (~130 bp) from each lane, limiting UV exposure to no more than 30 seconds.
Extract preparations from excised gel slices either by using a commercial gel-extraction kit or eluting directly from the gel slice into water (40 µl NFW in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube).
Hold gel slices overnight at 4°C, and collect the eluent the following morning.
Collect a small aliquot (~2-10 μl) from each preparation.
Combine the collected aliquots in a multiplex pool for sequencing.
Store remaining preparations for 6 months at -20°C.
Sample stored preparations again for sequencing if additional coverage is required.
